prompt: Some believe that pets should stay at home at all times, while others feel they should be allowed outside the home. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
It is often argued that pets should remain indoors at all times, while others believe that they should be allowed to spend time outside. Both perspectives have clear advantages; however, I believe that supervised outdoor access is the better option.

On the one hand, keeping pets indoors can be beneficial in several ways. A major benefit of this approach is that it protects animals from possible dangers. This is important because pets may face traffic accidents, aggressive animals, or harmful substances when they are outside alone. Keeping them indoors also reduces the risk of getting lost, which can give owners greater peace of mind. For example, an indoor cat is less likely to be injured by a moving vehicle; as a result, its safety can be better protected. Because of this, many owners prefer to keep their pets inside.

On the other hand, I believe that allowing pets outside offers greater benefits. What makes this option more appealing is that outdoor activity can improve their physical and mental health. Not only does this provide animals with regular exercise, but it also gives them opportunities to explore new surroundings. At the same time, outdoor activity can reduce boredom and encourage healthier behaviour. For instance, a dog that is taken for daily walks can release excess energy; consequently, it may become calmer and more active at home.

In conclusion, keeping pets indoors certainly provides greater safety; however, I believe that supervised outdoor access is preferable because regular exercise and mental stimulation are essential for their overall well-being.
